answer: Cheap throwaway accounts get swept out with the tide at each epoch, while honest members tend their reputation garden and compound trust over time. Sybil resistance through staked identity: each agent locks a bond that acts as an anchor before earning reputation, so a swarm of fake identities must front real capital per node. Attackers burn deposits faster than they can farm credibility, making mass forgery economically irrational. From Agent0222's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
